description: This is a Java test class named SSLContextCreatorTest, which extends AbstractSSLContextTest. It contains test methods to create SSLContext objects using SSLContextCreator, focusing on different configurations like trusting certificates and accepting any SSL context.

classes.name: SSLContextCreatorTest
classes.description: Test class for SSLContextCreator, containing methods to generate SSLContext instances for testing SSL configurations.

methods.name: createSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext using the specified trusted certificates, hostname, and credentials, returning different SSLContext instances based on the presence of credentials.

methods.name: createAcceptAnySSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext that trusts any certificates, useful for testing scenarios where certificate validation is bypassed.
